_comment: Which portfolio each code folder belongs to, plus a drafted starting project per repo (outcome, done_when, test_cmd, priority). Paths are relative to ~/codes. Cockpit's "Start a project" prefills the form from `draft`; edit the text there before creating the charter. Drafts are based on each repo's README/docs on 2026-11-01; `confidence: low` means the repo had little to go on.

draft.outcome: Ship APA 7 Review v1 to TestFlight with the 30-day Submission Pass working end to end.
done_when: APACore tests pass (203+), including parity with the Python backend
The non-renewing subscription com.aithrival.apa7review.pass30 is purchasable in a sandbox/StoreKit test
A sample .docx review completes in the app and the annotated .docx can be shared
App Store listing, privacy and support text are drafted for review (not submitted)

draft.test_cmd: xcodebuild test -project Changes.xcodeproj -scheme Changes -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
draft.outcome: Get Changes through App Review by answering Apple's Guideline 2.1 request with a complete reply and a safe release build.
done_when: The review reply text and 3-minute recording script match the current app and listing (you record the video and submit)
The release build calls the Supabase changes-ai proxy and contains no API key (checked by a build-settings audit)
ChangesTests pass on the simulator
Listing, privacy and support pages are current and consistent with the in-app purchase terms

draft.outcome: Turn Business Talk from a local prototype into the Phase 2 app shell: Home, Practice and History tabs over mock AI services.
done_when: Tab navigation (Home, Practice, History) replaces the filter-panel UI
Home shows score trend, skill breakdown and streak from local data
TranscriptionService, ReviewService and ConversationService exist as protocols with mock implementations
Unit tests for models, persistence, scoring aggregation and expiry pass; the app builds for the simulator

draft.test_cmd: xcodebuild test -project NearTale.xcodeproj -scheme NearTale -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -parallel-testing-enabled NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
draft.outcome: Make NearTale TestFlight-ready: verified sources, cleared imagery and green tests.
done_when: All unit and UI tests pass with the documented simulator command
Every published story has a named source URL, verification date and review status (audit report)
Every bundled place photo has a recorded source and licence; unlicensed ones are listed for replacement
A TestFlight checklist and privacy copy are drafted for review

draft.outcome: Prove SpendWise's core loop: log spending, earn XP, post a Jury vote and see it voted on from a phone.
done_when: Logging, XP and streak logic are covered by passing unit tests
A Jury vote page is hosted and works from a phone browser, with live tallies
The free-tier limits (3 votes a month, 1 goal) are verified in the simulator with the StoreKit file
A short status note lists what is left before TestFlight

draft.outcome: Finish Consultant Career as a daily interview-prep app and get a first build on a device.
done_when: The app builds and runs in the simulator with all 8 prep guides
Unit tests exist for the guide data and pass
A status note lists what is left before TestFlight

draft.outcome: Deliver DataHub Phase 1: enrichment steps and an authenticated REST API so the ai-news dataset is published as an API.
done_when: `datahub run ai-news` runs dedupe, fetch_content and llm steps, and a second run inserts 0 duplicates
The REST endpoint returns the ai-news digest with API-key auth, and a request without a key gets 401
The test suite passes and the Phase 1 acceptance command from detail-plan.md is recorded with its output

draft.test_cmd: cd Packages/CircleCore && xcodebuild test -scheme CircleCore -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17'
draft.outcome: Deliver FamilyOrbit milestone M3: a Family Now screen with every member's local time and calendar events correct across time zones.
done_when: TimeZoneKit unit tests pass, including all-day events that are never converted between time zones
EventKit sync fills the events table with calendar visibility rules applied (supabase test db passes)
A Sydney viewer sees a Toronto member's 9 am event at the right Sydney time (you check on a real phone)
CircleCore and Shared tests pass

micropace.note: Notice → Calendar v1: not built yet; project notice-calendar-v1

draft.outcome: Make the Voicebox TTS portal dependable for repeated LAN use.
done_when: Unit tests pass
A multi-page text with [pause: 2s] generates a playable zip from another device on the LAN
Only one generation runs at a time and the page shows its progress or queue position

draft.test_cmd: npm run lint && npm run build
draft.outcome: Ship the family account book MVP: real sign-in and a usable UI over the existing API.
done_when: Session sign-in replaces the x-user-email header
The UI can create account books and accounts and add or bulk-import transactions
The dashboard shows balances in the base currency with the ECB FX toggle
Lint and build pass; household data stays on this machine (no cloud model sees real transactions)

draft.outcome: Get Portfolio Tracker's ASX Vanguard ETF tracking working locally through holdings and transactions.
done_when: The test suite passes
An Excel import loads a sample file into holdings and transactions
The dashboard shows holdings value and performance from a price feed
Real holdings data stays on this machine (no cloud model sees it)
